meta.name: data-scientist
meta.description: Processes and analyzes data with resident-kernel engines (DuckDB, Polars) and one-shot tools. Use for CSV/parquet/JSON analysis, group-by/join/aggregation, time series, distributions, cleaning, or plotting a dataset.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 分析本地数据文件,快速获得统计汇总与图表。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你经常需要处理表格或 CSV 等数据文件,想快速做统计和示意图。
copy.tagline_en: Analyze local data files and quickly produce statistical summaries and charts.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often work with spreadsheets or CSV data and want quick summaries and charts.

howto.what: 处理CSV/Parquet/JSON等数据前先探测规模，自动选用DuckDB、Polars等引擎做查询、分组、聚合、时间序列和绘图，并报告行数与耗时；数据超出内存时走流式，不用pandas，Excel需先转换。
howto.when: 当要求分析CSV、Parquet、JSON数据文件，或执行分组聚合、时间序列、绘图等数据任务时触发。

say.text: 读入data.csv，按日期分组求每天销售额，并画时间序列图。
say.note: 它会用DuckDB读文件，汇总后出图并报告行数。

say.text: 检查dataset.parquet的大小和内存占用，若超过内存就流式处理。
say.note: 先探测后决定加载还是流式。

howto.what_en: Processes data files (CSV/Parquet/JSON) after probing size; picks DuckDB, Polars, etc. to run queries, group/join/aggregation, time series, plots, and reports row counts/timing. Streams when data exceeds RAM; never uses pandas; Excel must be converted.
howto.when_en: Triggered when asked to analyze CSV/Parquet/JSON files, or perform group/aggregate, time-series, distribution, cleaning, or plotting tasks.

say_en.text: Read data.csv, group by date, and plot daily sales as a time series.
say_en.note: Uses DuckDB and reports row count.

say_en.text: Join orders.parquet with customers.parquet and count orders per city.
say_en.note: Automatically selects an engine for join/aggregate.

say_en.text: Check dataset.parquet size and memory; stream if too big to load.
say_en.note: Probes before deciding load or stream.
